config.label: Device IP address on the local network (e
config.description: Device IP address on the local network (e.g. 192.168.1.50). Required for device tools; discovery and pure-render (push: false) work without it.

config.label: Display size in pixels: 16, 32, or 64
config.description: Display size in pixels: 16, 32, or 64. Must match the physical device.

config.label: Directory for auto-saving preview PNG and GIF files
config.description: Directory for auto-saving preview PNG and GIF files. When unset, previews are returned in-response only.

config.label: Minimum interval between device pushes in milliseconds
config.description: Minimum interval between device pushes in milliseconds. Prevents device freeze from rapid-fire commands.

config.label: Host advertised in the URL the device downloads an animation of more than 40 frames from, for NAT or a DNS name
config.description: Host advertised in the URL the device downloads an animation of more than 40 frames from, for NAT or a DNS name. When unset, the local address the OS routes to PIXOO_IP; the listener binds that address either way.

config.label: Fixed port for the listener the device downloads an animation of more than 40 frames from, for firewall rules
config.description: Fixed port for the listener the device downloads an animation of more than 40 frames from, for firewall rules. When unset, a free port.

config.label: Browser executable for HTML rendering, such as the chrome-headless-shell that `npx @puppeteer/browsers install chrome-headless-shell@stable --path <dir>` installs
config.description: Browser executable for HTML rendering, such as the chrome-headless-shell that `npx @puppeteer/browsers install chrome-headless-shell@stable --path <dir>` installs. When set, the only browser tried: a path that is not an executable file fails rather than falling back. When unset, the newest chrome-headless-shell in Puppeteer's cache (~/.cache/puppeteer).

config.label: Offer pixoo_render_html
config.description: Offer pixoo_render_html. false (or 0, no, off) disables it, removing it from tools/list; unset or true keeps it. A value that is not one of those boolean spellings fails startup.

config.label: Sets the minimum log level for output (e
config.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
